steps.body: A double adds a number to itself. Doubles are the first facts worth knowing on sight, because so many other facts lean on them.
steps.narration: A double adds a number to itself. Doubles are the first facts worth knowing on sight, because so many other facts lean on them.

widget.prompt: Fill the frame to show double 4.

commonCounts.feedback: That leaves the frame with only the first group of 4. A double needs a second group the same size.
That is one short of double 4. The second group must match the first exactly.

widget.missFeedback: Count the dots already there, then add just enough to reach 8.

predict.prompt: You will add a second group of 4 to a frame that already holds 4. What will the frame show?
predict.reveal: A double adds the whole group again, not one more dot: 4 and 4 make 8.
